title: S3 AccessDenied 403 / Bucket Policy Explicit Deny
symptom: IAM principal receives 'An error occurred (AccessDenied) when calling the GetObject operation' accessing S3 bucket.
initial_observations: Principal has AdministratorAccess IAM policy attached.
Request is still denied by Amazon S3.
environment: Amazon S3 bucket with Bucket Policy.

possible_causes.cause: Explicit Deny statement in the S3 Bucket Policy overrides IAM Allow
possible_causes.evidence_needed: Bucket policy contains Statement with Effect: Deny matching principal or missing Condition exception.
possible_causes.remediation: Audit bucket policy conditions (e.g. aws:PrincipalArn, aws:sourceVpce, aws:SecureTransport) and update.

possible_causes.cause: S3 Block Public Access enabled at account or bucket level blocking access
possible_causes.remediation: Review and configure Block Public Access settings if public/cross-account access was intended.

investigation_steps.title: Retrieve and Inspect S3 Bucket Policy
investigation_steps.command: aws s3api get-bucket-policy --bucket my-bucket --query Policy --output text | jq .
investigation_steps.explanation: Look for explicit Deny statements that override identity permissions.
investigation_steps.what_to_look_for: Effect: Deny blocks and condition logic.

investigation_steps.title: Check Bucket and Account Public Access Block
investigation_steps.explanation: Verify if BlockPublicAccess settings reject the request.
investigation_steps.what_to_look_for: True values on BlockPublicPolicy or RestrictPublicBuckets.

verification: Run `aws s3 cp s3://my-bucket/test.txt .` and confirm download succeeds.
prevention: Use IAM Policy Simulator to test policy evaluations before deploying bucket policies.
Always include NotPrincipal or Condition exclusions when using broad Deny statements.
